name: delete_repository
description: Delete a repository the person named, for good. It needs the bypass access tier, and `confirm` must be the repository's `owner/name` exactly (a guard against a slip: nothing is deleted when it differs). GitHub's own rules and the permissions of your credentials decide whether it happens: if it refuses you get its words, and you tell the person.

repo.description: The repository the person named: `owner/name`, or its address

confirm.description: The repository's `owner/name` again, exactly: the guard against deleting the wrong one
